subject: silken-embrace
q: Four Fairbrooks women exist now, and the schema has nowhere to put them.
detail:
SABLE compiled the store guide and is A REGULAR AT THE LUCKY HAMMER — Sera's bar — rather than shop staff, which makes the guide a customer's love letter rather than corporate literature, and explains its tone completely. Her sign-off says she was ALREADY WAITING IN A CHANGING BOOTH.

SIENNA is a Concierge at Silken Embrace: tall, Junoesque stature, third-floor pencil skirt. MAYA is her GIRLFRIEND, and was affirmed the day of the journey the guide records — Athletic-Seductress, Perk-Bubble, 36-24-38, eight inches, CHERRY GUMMY on her tongue. And there is an unnamed blue-haired woman who opened the wrong fitting room door and did not immediately leave.

None of them live in a Haven. None are devotion-locked to a resident. The girls collection is built around three houses and cannot hold ordinary affirmed women of Fairbrooks — the same gap already filed against Marianne, Cassandra, the twelve daughters, Eden, Dia, Ragnar, James and Nona Valentina. THE WORLD IS LARGER THAN THREE HOUSES and the schema has not caught up.

MAYA'S CHERRY GUMMY STAYS REGARDLESS: independent corroboration of the delivery mechanism from a document that had no reason to mention it — one gummy, flavoured, dissolving, and the body rewriting itself in the minutes after, jeans splitting and buttons going.
